units.source_text: 观众之中，有些中等人家的女子，将衣服披在头顶，戴上女笠，扎起衣裾，徒步往来。

en.t: Among the spectators, some women from middle-class households draped their robes over their heads, put on women's hats, tucked up their hems, and walked back and forth on foot.

units.source_text: 又有看破红尘、出家修行的尼姑，也跌跌撞撞地出来看热闹。

en.t: There were also nuns who had renounced the world and entered religious practice, stumbling out as well to watch the excitement.

units.source_text: 要是平时，见者一定嫌她们好事：“你们这种人何苦来呢！”

en.t: At any ordinary time, anyone who saw them would surely have scorned them as busybodies, saying, "Why should people like you trouble yourselves to come here?"

units.source_text: 但在今日，大家认为理之当然。

en.t: But today, everyone thought it only natural.

units.source_text: 更有形状古怪的老太婆，牙齿脱落，两颊深陷，

en.t: There were also strange-looking old women, their teeth fallen out and both cheeks deeply sunken,

units.source_text: 将垂在背后的头发藏在衣服里面，驼腰曲背，

en.t: with the hair hanging down their backs hidden inside their robes, their waists bent and backs hunched,

units.source_text: 以手加额，仰望源氏大将的容姿，目瞪口呆，竟像发痴一般。

en.t: pressing a hand to the forehead as they gazed up at General Genji's figure, staring open-mouthed as if half crazed.

units.source_text: 其中还有无知无识的平民，忘记了自己相貌的丑陋，欢欣鼓舞地笑着。

en.t: Among them were ignorant commoners who forgot the plainness of their own looks and laughed in delighted excitement.

units.source_text: 还有微不足道的地方官的女儿，为源氏大将所不屑寓目的，

en.t: There were also daughters of insignificant provincial officials, girls General Genji would not have deigned to notice,

units.source_text: 也乘着竭力装饰得华丽的车子，故意装出娇媚之态，

en.t: who too rode in carriages decorated as splendidly as they could manage, deliberately putting on an alluring air,
hoping to win the general's favor.
There were all sorts of people, too many to describe fully.

units.source_text: 就中有几个曾与大将私通的女子，看到他今天的雄姿，自惭形秽，背人叹息。

en.t: Among them were several women who had once had secret affairs with the general; seeing his splendid bearing today, they felt ashamed of their own unworthiness and sighed in private.
